title: SOS cancel path skips trust-store verify_or_pin (defense-in-depth parity)
description: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:285-301 (_cancel_from_body) mirrors render_delete in never consulting self._trust_store.verify_or_pin, which the activation path enforces (emergency.py:252-256). Cancel authorization rests on IID-derivation + signature; exploiting requires a second key colliding on the victim's 8-byte IID (~2^63), so this is defense-in-depth parity with DELETE, not an introduced gap. Either add the check for parity with activate or document the divergence deliberately.
